bibl.title: Poll Tax Receipt from Arsinoe (P.Mich. inv. 1336; 133 CE)
bibl.seg: Valentina Iannace, Poll Tax Receipt from Arsinoe (P.Mich. inv. 1336; 133 CE).
bibl.note: The taxpayer was a metropolite, and perhaps the protagonist of a small family archive from second century Theadelpheia. Discusses the handwriting of the professional scribe of this document, who wrote other poll tax receipts spanning from 133 to 148 CE. Arsinoe, 4 Sep. 133 CE.
